spec: Python 3 module `intervals.py` defining `merge_intervals(intervals)`: takes a list of [start, end] pairs (ints) and returns a NEW list of merged [start, end] lists sorted by start.
properties: overlapping intervals are merged into one spanning both
intervals that merely touch (end == next start) are merged too
the output is sorted by start regardless of input order
the input list and its inner lists are not mutated; an empty input returns []
a pair with start > end raises ValueError
